source.runtime_equivalence: c65f938 differs from c92a2ef only by one analysis README

production_baseline.final_wave_ownership: The lower 16 CTAs own one final row quad per warp; the upper 16 CTAs have no third row quad.
production_baseline.cta_local_epilogue_contract: After a CTA-local barrier, each CTA reads only raw Down rows written by that same CTA before the first grid-wide RMSNorm barrier.

candidate.name: scale6 balanced final wave
candidate.intended_mechanism: Keep the first 4096 rows on the production row-quad schedule, then assign two adjacent rows to every warp across all 32 CTAs for the final 1024 rows.
candidate.parallelism_change: Final-wave ownership changes from 16 CTAs x 16 warps x 4 rows to 32 CTAs x 16 warps x 2 rows.

scale6_overhead.reason: The existing 96-byte row-quad/K512 scale tile is read independently by both row-pair warps.
scale6_overhead.claim_limit: No NCU run was made, so these are logical request bytes and not a DRAM-traffic claim.

resources.method: cuobjdump --dump-resource-usage plus the public cudaFuncGetAttributes/cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor query on the final ELF

candidate.graph_contract: One cooperative fused Down/residual/RMSNorm kernel node; the explicit environment admission was evaluated before Graph capture.

correctness_root_cause.finding: The candidate changed projection ownership without changing the CTA-local residual epilogue ownership or adding a grid barrier.
correctness_root_cause.synchronization: Only __syncthreads separates projection from residual publication; the first cooperative grid sync occurs after residual publication for RMSNorm.
correctness_root_cause.failure_mode: Residual publication reads raw Down rows produced by other CTAs without an inter-CTA happens-before edge.
possible_repairs_not_run: Remap the residual tail so each CTA consumes its own 32 candidate rows while retaining the two production 64-row prefix waves.
Insert a grid-wide barrier between projection and residual publication.
correctness_root_cause.stop_reason: The architecture already regressed the public whole-runner performance gate, so correctness repair and further GPU work have no retention value.

excluded_runs.reason: The first local baseline omitted the all-prompt and single-arbitrary-tile production admissions and measured 166.216 prompt tok/s.
excluded_runs.disposition: invalid and deleted; no candidate request was measured against it

excluded_runs.reason: A later candidate engine creation overlapped a second model server and failed the complete NVFP4 Marlin sidecar memory margin.
excluded_runs.disposition: invalid infrastructure race; no request was measured

decision.reopen_conditions: Do not reopen this equal-byte row-pair tail mapping. A new Down architecture must reduce load-issue/address dependency or physical traffic, preserve CTA-local epilogue ownership, and first pass the real OpenAI-compatible runner gate.
decision.next_direction: K512 consumer-order weight sidecar/wavefront that reduces per-warp LDG issue and address dependency while retaining exact scale6 arithmetic.

claim_limits: The EvalScope comparison is one external eight-request direction cell against the frozen runtime-equivalent c92a2ef result, not a release benchmark.
Because generated outputs diverged, the timing delta is independently disqualifying but is not used as a clean kernel-only attribution.
No Nsys or NCU profile was run after the public runner rejected the candidate.
The 2-CTA resource result is valid for the built candidate but does not imply numerical or performance eligibility.
Production Decode, Prefill, the frozen vLLM reference, and the formal project anchor remain unchanged.
